message: 街にある魔地

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there~!」
I greet a shopkeeper who's been good to me. On my way home, I decided to treat myself to a leisurely weekend stroll.

name: Synn
message: 「I really like the shopping district on Sundays. Unlike weekdays, it's got this unique sense of excitement to it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No toys in your room. No money to go shopping either.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Brainwashing yourself into calling it a 'stroll' while people-watching for talented recruits--truly worthy of the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you always interpret things so maliciously?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Whoa! Ooh.」
A little ways ahead, under the eaves of Yuugiri-an. My eyes meet Nanaka's as she's wiping down the entrance door, and I give her a light nod.
Nanaka nods back at me with a smile, quickly finishes wiping the display case, and heads back inside the shop.

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh... Did you have a lovers' quarrel with Soba or something, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「No. Why do you ask?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Normally, Soba would be right up in your personal space, chattering away all bubbly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Usually, yeah. Right now she's helping out at the shop, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Despite how she looks, Nanaka's the type to draw a strict line between work and her private life.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you and Soba just awkward?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, whatever. Let's go tease her while she works and treat ourselves to some tempura zaru soba.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, maybe next time.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're holding back too much. There's no line, and the lunchtime rush is already over, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true that on weekends, it doesn't get overwhelmingly slammed right at mealtime.」

name: Synn
message: 「Instead, there's a steady, endless stream of customers coming in to eat.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see, that'd be bad then.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you two started up your usual married-couple comedy routine in front of random customers, your dignity as the Demon Lord would be completely ruined.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I don't have the money to eat a luxury like tempura zaru anyway.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So that's the real reason!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow...! I'm terribly sorry, are you hurt?」

name: Shio
message: 「No, it is I who have been rude」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, it's just the naginata brat. What's the big rush?」

name: Synn
message: 「Heading back from club activities? Hello, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Synn-dono and the specter!」

name: Shio
message: 「At this very moment, I am being pursued by a villain... If possible, I would like you to shelter me」

name: Synn
message: 「A villain? Don't tell me it's a Demon--」

name: Misa
message: 「Found you!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, catch Shio for me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Even if you tell me that out of nowhere... L-Like this? *Squeeze*...」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Synn-dono, if you hold my hand by linking our pinkies together like that, I will get embarrassed, you know...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, how indecent-cent-cent-cent! You're disqualified from being Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you tell me to do this, Misa?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No she didn't」

name: Misa
message: 「Keep your hands off Shio! Hiyah!!」
Rushing over, Misa separates Shio-chan and me with a splendid knife-hand strike. Then, in one fluid motion, she firmly grasps Shio-chan's hand.

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! Cau-ght you~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Gasp!? Y-You betrayed me, Synn-dono. To fluster me and make me let my guard down... Truly worthy of the Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop complimenting me like Paqy would!」

name: Synn
message: 「--Wait, so the 'villain' was Misa?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! I just want to go shopping with Shio」

name: Misa
message: 「Come now, let's head to the clothing store」

name: Shio
message: 「A-As you command! Though I am but a humble warrior, now that it has come to this, I shall resign myself to my fate with grace」

name: Shio
message: 「However! ...Y-You must not use me as a dress-up doll, understood?」

name: Misa
message: 「I won't, I won't. I wouldn't do anything you hate, Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「...Y-You promise?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, looks like everything's settled? Well, I shouldn't intrude, so I'll be heading off」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun!」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Ummm...」

name: Misa
message: 「Inhaaaale. Exhaaaale. ...Hmph!」

name: Misa
message: 「Regarding the matter of you catching Shio, I am not unwilling to express my gratitude to you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the short version is?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you」

name: Synn
message: 「You're welcome」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh! Allow me to thank you once again. Bow, bow, bow!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, the pleasure is all mine. Bow, bow, bow, bow, bow, bow, bow, bow, bow, bow」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! At this rate, I'll lose. In that case, my only choice is to grovel--ah!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You played me like a fiddle and tricked me into thanking you honestly, didn't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, don't get cocky! You think that means you beat me? I only thanked you on purpose just now, okay!」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister, that excuse is rather strained...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nnggh... S-Stand by for a moment, Sakura-kun!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, Miss Hissy over there is desperately trying to think up an excuse, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa, Paqy! Shhh」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm, hmm... Mmm-hmm?」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister, running into Lord Synn here must be fate. How about asking him to accompany us on our shopping trip?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan, there's no way Misa would ever agree to th--」

name: Misa
message: 「Right. If it's convenient for you, Sakura-kun, I'd like you to join us.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Misa inviting me out? This has to be a dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「To wake up and return to the real world... Paqy, hit me with everything you've got!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Got it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ow. Ngh... Still not waking up, though. Hit me harder!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, you're blushing like crazy, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What are you doing...?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-If you don't want to, you don't have to tag along, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But, look, um... oh, right!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ryuusei Town is peaceful, sure, but there might be some rowdy guys out on their day off, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「It'd be awful if someone like that tried to hit on Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister, with all due respect, I am quite capable of protecting myself--」

name: Misa
message: 「...*glare*」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun is around, he'll at least serve as a bodyguard.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so that's what this is about. Got it. And I'll carry your bags too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes... You're so slow on the uptake, you're disqualified as Student Council President.」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, let's go.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, what a troublesome pair.」

name: Shio
message: 「I quite agree.」

name: Misa
message: 「That surprised me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. To think they would announce a discount before we even chose our items.」
Under the eaves of the clothing store, Misa and Shio-chan have their eyes wide open in surprise.

name: Misa
message: 「You certainly know a lot of people, Sakura-kun. To think you're even acquainted with a clothing store.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, the shopkeeper here gives me fabric scraps, you see.」

name: Synn
message: 「I collect all sorts of scraps and use patchwork to make aprons, or try making kotatsu covers and things.」

name: Synn
message: 「And if they turn out well, they let me display them here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, there are also ones I don't hand over and just use myself.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry, this kind of talk sounds pretty domestic, doesn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No! Not at all. It's a wonderful hobby.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah!? You thanked me so honestly! That makes us even for earlier!」
Misa's usual reaction.
I don't really understand why myself, but I feel relieved.
Surprisingly, Misa's favorite spot wasn't a high-end boutique, but the shopping district's clothing store that Nanaka and I also frequent.
Misa happily browses through the bargain clothes lined up at the storefront.

name: Shio
message: 「Sneak, sneak...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, that over there is the men's section, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Putting men's wear right next to gal fashion is pure chaos.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a small shop, after all. Once you get used to it, it's pretty convenient, you know? Families can drop by casually, too.」

name: Shio
message: 「A-Elder Sister, I too wish to contribute to the fabric scraps. Rather than a skirt, I shall play it safe and purchase jeans--」

name: Misa
message: 「Nothing that plain! Cute clothes will definitely suit you, Shio!」

name: Misa
message: 「For example--yes, something like this is lovely.」
Misa picks up a super girly outfit and holds it up against Shio-chan.

name: Synn
message: 「You've got great taste, Misa. It really brings out your charm, Shio-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course! It is for Shio's sake, after all.」

name: Shio
message: 「B-But I was hoping for some stylish modern-day kimono...」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, there are bound to be other clothes that suit you even better--my!! How about this one?」

name: Shio
message: 「A-A-A-Big Sister, such a frilly and fluttery outfit is... T-The color is to my liking, however」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doll-like clothes on the naginata brat, huh? Tickles a connoisseur's fancy. I've got newfound respect for Hisu」

name: Shio
message: 「Putting a garment overflowing with frills like that on an expressionless girl such as myself--」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? You're super expressive, Shio. It's just hard to tell unless someone gets close to you」

name: Shio
message: 「N-Nay. I have cultivated an unshakable mind through the martial arts. To carelessly let my expression shift would be--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--?! I found an even better outfit! Look, look, it's the classiest one yet!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek?! W-Where on earth do you expect me to wear a dress that's so extravagantly poofy...!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ahem! Big Sister, did you not declare that you would not treat me like a dress-up doll?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, and I'm not, am I? I'm just holding different outfits up against you」

name: Shio
message: 「C-Careless of me! I have been deceived」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha」
Oh, I get it...!
Watching Misa and Shio-chan playfully banter like real sisters, I suddenly realize.
When we bumped into each other earlier, Shio-chan wasn't actually trying to run away in earnest.
If she truly hated picking out clothes, all she had to do was shake off my hand and run off somewhere.
It's the same for Misa.
She didn't want to make Shio-chan--her little sister, who had invited me along--lose face.
So she came up with all sorts of excuses to bring me along... Man, the bond between these two is great. I'm jealous.

name: Shio
message: 「It seems we have taken quite a bit of time」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, it really is true that time flies when you're having fun」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry I couldn't be of any help」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mmph, mmph-mmph」
I apologize to the two of them while covering Paqy's mouth.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, I did say 'having fun,' didn't I? Lift your head up」

name: Synn
message: 「*Jerk!*」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, don't lean all the way back like you're hot stuff!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Big Sister, where shall we head next? We still have time, so shall we visit the Blackuma shop as usual--」

name: Misa
message: 「Waaah, waaah, waaah!」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmph, mmmph!」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sakura-kun, did you hear anything? You didn't, right? Yes, that's right」

name: Synn
message: 「A Blackuma shop, huh~~ You're pretty cute, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, you!」
Misa lets go of Shio-chan's mouth and presses in close to me.

name: Misa
message: 「L-Like I'd ever go to a shop like that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, okay. Well, that's fine then. A clothing store is one thing, but that place would be embarrassing for me too...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hehehe... *grin*」

name: Shio
message: 「M-My Lady, a corrupt magistrate's wicked smirk graces your noble visage--」

name: Misa
message: 「*Glare!*」

name: Shio
message: 「I-It is nothing at all!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, we're going to the Blackuma shop next. You're going to carry my bags for me, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huuuh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hold on! Didn't you literally just say you weren't going?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, what year, month, day, hour, minute, and second did I say that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misa...!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Sigh*~, well, it can't be helped. I'll stick with you till the end today」

name: Shio
message: 「Kufufu, you could run away if you truly wished to, yet you are just like me, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's not say that out loud」
I accept my fate with a clear conscience and walk alongside Misa and Shio-chan toward the novelty shop.

name: Paqy
message: 「Mgh, m... gh... *slump*, goes limp--」
